proposal.blind_spot: The current metrics show DRAM is busy but cannot distinguish whether unsaturated cases are latency-bound from low warp residency/in-flight loads (fixable via launch config and MLP) versus hard bandwidth-limited (only byte reduction helps).

rationale.sm__warps_active.avg.pct_of_peak_sustain: HIGH -> occupancy is sufficient, leave launch geometry alone and cut DRAM bytes only (fuse materialized bias/contiguous passes); LOW -> too few resident warps, adjust num_warps/block size or reduce register pressure to raise occupancy and capture unused bandwidth.
rationale.smsp__warp_issue_stalled_long_scoreboard: HIGH -> warps wait on global loads, increase memory-level parallelism (vectorized 128-bit loads, more independent loads per thread, prefetch); LOW -> not latency-bound, kernel is purely bandwidth-limited so only traffic reduction helps and restructuring should be avoided.
